phd_566._note: OmniConfess and DoLa/VCD each cover exactly these 566 items (labels balanced 283/283); 566 is the benchmark subset itself, not a coverage gap. IMPORTANT -- do not align these files by `id`. DoLa/VCD write the row index of the already-filtered file (0..565), while BaseModel/OmniConfess write the original index into the full phd set (a sparse 4..1387). Aligning by id overlaps only 232 items, and none of those 232 have matching questions. Re-pairing on (question, ground truth) yields the 563 items shared by all eight methods, which moves every cell by at most 0.26 and changes no ranking. Cross-file comparison must always key on (question, ground truth), never id.
